summary:
ANKAHE NISHAAN — The Story of Opportunity

Developed by: UTC TECH

ANKAHE NISHAAN is an interactive digital e-book inspired by NASA’s Opportunity rover mission. It presents Opportunity’s story through readable digital storytelling, relevant images, transitions from images into videos, and interactive elements.

Readers can explore the content at their own pace, view visual material, transition from selected images into video experiences, and interact with selected elements throughout the book.

Core Features:

- Readable digital e-book
- Images integrated into the story
- Image-to-video transitions
- Interactive elements for the reader

Project Goal: To present the story of NASA’s Opportunity rover through an engaging and interactive digital reading experience.

Team: UTC TECH
details:
Project Details — ANKAHE NISHAAN

ANKAHE NISHAAN is an interactive digital e-book inspired by NASA’s Opportunity rover mission. The project aims to make the story of Opportunity accessible through a visual and interactive reading experience.

The e-book combines written content with images that support the story. Selected images can transition into videos, helping readers move from reading to visual storytelling. Interactive elements allow readers to engage with selected parts of the content rather than simply reading passively.

The experience is designed so readers can explore the content at their own pace through a digital reader interface.

Main Components:

- Digital e-book reader for structured storytelling.
- Images integrated into the reading experience.
- Image-to-video transitions.
- Interactive elements within selected content.
- Reader controls such as language selection and text-size adjustment.

Purpose: To present the story of NASA’s Opportunity rover in an accessible, visual and interactive digital format.

Developed by: UTC TECH
